Toughpower GF1 650W Snow - TT Premium Edition
The fully modular Toughpower GF1 Snow Edition series comes in 850W and built to deliver 80 PLUS Gold efficiency. Toughpower GF1 Snow 850W features flat white cables, a 140mm hydraulic bearing fan, Japanese capacitors and other premium components to help deliver a continuous and stable power with an ambient temperature up to 50°C, while near silent operation and reliable performance are guaranteed. With an ample 10-year warranty, the Toughpower GF1 850W Snow Gold can satisfy PC enthusiasts who are looking for a white premium power supply with all the latest features. For users who crave for a pure white build, this power supply can defenitely meet their demand.

Fully Modular Low-Profile Flat Cable
Fully modular low-profile flat cables offer cable selection while powering the system at an advantageous voltage. By only connecting the cables your system needs, cable management is easier, clutter is reduced, and the airflow inside the chassis is increased.
